# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-28d5f74c

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:01:28 | NODE_A, NODE_C | 13 | CRITICAL |

## 2. Executive Summary
A simultaneous Navigation Database Refresh Cycle initiated on both the Master (NODE_A) and Spare (NODE_C) Flight Management System (FMS) nodes resulted in a critical loss of system redundancy. The concurrent update triggered a state transition from Dual mode to Single mode, forcing a reconfiguration of the FMS node hierarchy to maintain basic operational availability.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was the simultaneous execution of a **Navigation Database Refresh Cycle** on both the Master and Spare FMS nodes `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 15 | UUID: 675e178f-7e11-4cb5-9198-c92aa465c74c]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 028cf4f9-5ee4-408a-8b38-da9fe99f125f]`. 

The failure mechanism is identified as a synchronization conflict during the database update process. Because both nodes attempted to refresh the navigation data concurrently, the distributed system could not maintain the "Dual" operational state, leading to a breakdown in the cross-channel monitoring and subsequent mode degradation.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence

1.  **[09:00:31] Initiation:** Operator interaction triggered a Navigation Database Refresh Cycle on NODE_A (Master/Captain position) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 15 | UUID: 675e178f-7e11-4cb5-9198-c92aa465c74c]` and simultaneously on NODE_C (Spare/First Officer position) `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 028cf4f9-5ee4-408a-8b38-da9fe99f125f]`.
2.  **[09:00:32] Guidance Instability:** The refresh cycle caused an immediate change in the Vertical Guidance Sequence on both nodes `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 16 | UUID: fef99cfd-c490-47f2-b43b-c720a9058ae9]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 18 | UUID: 6c5b37c2-eb69-44e9-8af8-22e2f713a2d2]`.
3.  **[09:00:33] Navigation Mode Shift:** Both nodes reported a change in L-navigation status to "L navigation hdg" (heading mode) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 29 | UUID: ad3e2a81-107e-4c84-833f-6f4b78a309f6]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 30 | UUID: 9c74f569-f16a-4887-bddd-54a51cf5c24c]`.
4.  **[09:01:21] Redundancy Loss:** The system officially transitioned from "Dual" mode to "Single" mode `[Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 31 | UUID: 864cc738-4a69-413b-ae93-75b2e7398c9b]`.
5.  **[09:01:22] Comm Reconfiguration:** Data link communication was reconfigured, with the slave node transitioning to master status `[Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 32 | UUID: 6c4e19fb-3c5e-4d58-b9d8-40191be60f8a]`.
6.  **[09:01:28] Final State Stabilization:** The FMS node position was reconfigured, with the Right FMS node assuming the Master role within the Single mode architecture `[Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 33 | UUID: 2839019f-41ec-4a9e-b922-d9ba318e8106]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment

*   **Redundancy Loss:** The system suffered a total loss of dual-mode redundancy, reverting to Single mode operation `[Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 31 | UUID: 864cc738-4a69-413b-ae93-75b2e7398c9b]`.
*   **Degraded Flight Management:** The transition caused a momentary disruption in vertical guidance and a shift in L-navigation status to heading-based guidance `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 16 | UUID: fef99cfd-c490-47f2-b43b-c720a9058ae9]` `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 29 | UUID: ad3e2a81-107e-4c84-833f-6f4b78a309f6]`.
*   **Functional Availability:** While the system maintained single-mode availability, the operational margin was significantly reduced due to the loss of the spare node's active synchronization.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions

1.  **Software Logic Update (Critical):** Implement a software interlock within the FMS management logic to prevent concurrent Navigation Database Refresh Cycles on Master and Spare nodes. The system should automatically inhibit a refresh on the Spare node if a Master refresh is in progress.
2.  **Bus Integrity Inspection:** Perform a high-fidelity inspection of the avionics data bus to ensure that the transition from Dual to Single mode was not exacerbated by packet collisions or latency during the high-load refresh period.
3.  **Operational Procedure Review:** Update Flight Crew Operating Manuals (FCOM) to include specific warnings regarding the necessity of staggered database updates to maintain FMS redundancy.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-9e50cb97

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:00:55 | NODE_C | 27 | CRITICAL |

## 2. Executive Summary
NODE_C experienced recurring real-time scheduling violations characterized by "Scheduled FMS Activity Missed Timing Requirement" (Fault Code 6000) [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022]. These deadline misses in background services occurred during high-workload flight plan modifications, resulting in a loss of system redundancy.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger is a real-time scheduling failure within NODE_C, specifically identified as a "Deadline miss" in background services 65563 and 65554 [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022; Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 78 | UUID: 7872b6ef-0597-4636-a958-242db28a7d55]. This failure mechanism manifested as a "Scheduled FMS Activity Missed Timing Requirement" (Code: 6000), indicating that the Flight Management System (FMS) could not complete critical background tasks within their allocated temporal windows [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022].

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Initial Timing Violation:** At 09:14:25, NODE_C logged a Code 6000 fault due to a background service deadline miss [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022].
2. **Redundancy Degradation:** The system was observed operating in "Dual mode: Single" status during the initial fault [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 6 | UUID: a7bd382e-99dc-485c-9d3d-782afb60eaab].
3. **Operator Interaction & Database Check:** Following an altitude selection of 18000.0 [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 12 | UUID: 8da0397e-56ca-447b-b907-84974590ef74], the operator entered origin and destination data (Eddf), triggering system-wide "Check data base cycle" messages [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: 6a38dc4b-f9b3-4d40-9c56-6fb4851d5a24; Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 15 | UUID: 462dffc2-eb04-43cf-93ba-7f49b03c6504].
4. **Secondary Timing Violation:** During the high-workload phase of entering an approach (25L) and initializing arrival procedures [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 16 | UUID: 10b06ce3-0ecc-4fee-91fb-fcd58f945151; Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 18 | UUID: e79d78b7-96d0-4767-aab9-20f748bdf69f], a second Code 6000 timing fault occurred at 09:15:20 [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 78 | UUID: 7872b6ef-0597-4636-a958-242db28a7d55].

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Loss:** The system was operating in a degraded "Single" mode rather than a dual-redundant configuration [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 6 | UUID: a7bd382e-99dc-485c-9d3d-782afb60eaab].
* **Functional Availability:** While the FMS remained "Operational," the recurring deadline misses during critical flight plan entry (Origin, Destination, Approach, and Arrival Procedure) pose a significant risk to the integrity of the flight management functions [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022; Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: b23db76f-164d-4e77-9d07-2645541050ac].

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Software/Kernel Audit:** Conduct a deep-dive analysis of background services 65563 and 65554 to identify the cause of the "Deadline miss" (e.g., priority inversion, infinite loops, or resource contention) [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: c2c2da4c-048d-454f-9049-bfd2dd66f022].
2. **Database Integrity Verification:** Perform a full validation of the FMS database cycle to ensure that database lookups are not causing excessive CPU utilization during operator input [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 15 | UUID: 462dffc2-eb04-43cf-93ba-7f49b03c6504].
3. **Hardware Diagnostic:** Inspect NODE_C for potential hardware-level timing issues or thermal throttling that could impact real-time task execution.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-999ff111

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:02:27 | NODE_C | 46 | WARNING |

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involves a sequence of manual Flight Management System (FMS) configuration entries performed by the First Officer while the avionics suite was operating in a non-redundant "Single" mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e]. The operator successfully updated weight, balance, and cruise parameters, but the system remained in a degraded redundancy state throughout the event.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a series of **Operator Interactions** initiated by the First Officer to reconfigure flight parameters [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e]. The failure mechanism is identified as a **Redundancy Loss State**, where the system was operating in "Dual mode: Single" [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 17b8a336-fe62-468a-a30b-75eec6500f04], necessitating manual entry of critical flight data including Zero Fuel Weight (ZFW) and Cost Index.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Initial Parameter Entry:** The operator entered an offset distance [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e] and inserted temporary flight plan data [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 31 | UUID: e1f3c612-e477-4d3a-b0d5-cccb2a747848].
2. **Display Configuration:** The flight display CP identifier was updated to Scale 10.0 in "Plan" mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 27 | UUID: e159327d-2d98-470e-9b68-667c73872fcf].
3. **Weight/Balance Update:** The operator entered ZFW [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 33 | UUID: 2c6cebf7-79cc-4b1b-b430-751d4f8505a3] followed by ZFWCG [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 34 | UUID: 55a44115-def0-414a-82c5-b36b663e31c5].
4. **Mode Engagement:** The system logged "Lrc mode in use" for both left and right message identifiers [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 29 | UUID: fa345265-abca-49a0-b996-a079186dca03] | [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 30 | UUID: 6f9e02e0-40f6-4453-bd96-ed4e5c26f582].
5. **Flight Level Finalization:** The operator entered the cruise flight level [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 38 | UUID: 9e21f4dd-b57b-4573-b314-574b5b85f6fa], which resulted in an FMS operational event noting "no phase change" [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 39 | UUID: 100abb80-98a5-4054-8f34-b326b2a39457].

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Loss:** The system was confirmed to be in "Dual mode: Single" [Source: NODE_C_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 17b8a336-fe62-468a-a30b-75eec6500f04], indicating a loss of FMS redundancy.
* **Degraded Flight Management:** The flight plan source was transitioned to "Temporary Efb" [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e], increasing reliance on manual operator input for mission-critical data.
* **Functional Availability:** While functional, the system was operating under a single-node master status [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e].

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Avionics Bus Inspection:** Perform a diagnostic check on the communication bus between NODE_C and its redundant counterpart to determine why the system failed to maintain "Dual" mode.
2. **Software Logic Audit:** Review the FMS software handling of "Temporary Efb" flight plan sources to ensure data integrity during manual transitions [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 28 | UUID: f7cb6680-e32d-4d93-a295-d1d73645450e].
3. **Hardware Redundancy Test:** Conduct a full functional test of the FMS Master/Slave handover logic to prevent future single-node operational states.

executive_summary: The incident involved a critical failure of the Flight Management System (FMS) following an operator interaction on NODE_C, which triggered a configuration integrity mismatch. This failure cascaded to NODE_A, resulting in widespread service identity failures, repository access errors, and the inability to load critical operating system libraries.
root_cause: The primary trigger was an operator interaction on NODE_C [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 59 | UUID: b31c205b-eb24-4f81-9278-457de4c76ac6], which immediately preceded an FMS Configuration Data Integrity Mismatch (Code: 5) [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 79 | UUID: 959aa76b-891f-4f92-876d-16b0f5f85147]. This mismatch prevented the FMS service from completing its start process, leading to repeated "Error during start process" (Code: 9) faults [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 80 | UUID: 6d8d7c93-1c3f-4f57-a0bb-42b6e09116b3].
cascade_sequence:
1. **09:36:45**: Operator interaction occurs on NODE_C while the system is in "Single" dual mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 59 | UUID: b31c205b-eb24-4f81-9278-457de4c76ac6].
2. **09:36:49**: NODE_C identifies a configuration data integrity mismatch [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 79 | UUID: 959aa76b-891f-4f92-876d-16b0f5f85147] and enters a loop of failed start processes [Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 84 | UUID: a47c3e40-e703-409a-b28a-80c5adc91a5d].
3. **09:37:22**: The failure propagates to NODE_A, which reports Background Service Identity Failures (Code: 6025) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: a43360a1-9a17-4f06-9f24-aed66cd2201c] and FMS Data Repository Access Failures (Code: 6074) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 6e575467-887b-404d-9c4c-1020fefc98bf].
4. **09:37:23**: NODE_A attempts to initialize but fails to load the critical library `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 3c329e54-f356-4e15-a945-2c15ff4b4e39].
5. **09:37:24**: NODE_A experiences total service degradation, including Oss bind failures (Code: 6035) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 37 | UUID: 8de54bb9-2a5f-4a29-ac16-e94874f64153] and task client failures (Code: 6024) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 45 | UUID: (Not provided in transcript)].
system_impact: The system suffered a total loss of FMS redundancy. NODE_C was operating in "Single" mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 59 | UUID: b31c205b-eb24-4f81-9278-457de4c76ac6]. Although NODE_A attempted to transition to "Dual" mode [Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: a0e270c5-6843-4683-9d79-9de7e8a4ca90], the functional availability was compromised by an "Fs end of file" error during repository access [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 6e575467-887b-404d-9c4c-1020fefc98bf], rendering the FMS non-operational.
corrective_actions:
1. **Data Integrity Audit**: Perform a full checksum validation and integrity check on the "Public FMS Artifact" files across all nodes to resolve the "Fs end of file" error [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 6e575467-887b-404d-9c4c-1020fefc98bf].
2. **Library Reinstallation**: Conduct a targeted reinstallation and verification of the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library on NODE_A to address the OSS loading failure [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 3c329e54-f356-4e15-a945-2c15ff4b4e39].
3. **Configuration Management Review**: Investigate the FMS configuration synchronization protocol to determine why an operator interaction on NODE_C resulted in a widespread data integrity mismatch.

1. **09:36:45**: Operator interaction occurs on NODE_C while the system is in "Single" dual mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 59 | UUID: b31c205b-eb24-4f81-9278-457de4c76ac6].

4. **09:37:23**: NODE_A attempts to initialize but fails to load the critical library `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 3c329e54-f356-4e15-a945-2c15ff4b4e39].
5. **09:37:24**: NODE_A experiences total service degradation, including Oss bind failures (Code: 6035) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 37 | UUID: 8de54bb9-2a5f-4a29-ac16-e94874f64153] and task client failures (Code: 6024) [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 45 | UUID: (Not provided in transcript)].

## 5. System Impact Assessment
The system suffered a total loss of FMS redundancy. NODE_C was operating in "Single" mode [Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 59 | UUID: b31c205b-eb24-4f81-9278-457de4c76ac6]. Although NODE_A attempted to transition to "Dual" mode [Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: a0e270c5-6843-4683-9d79-9de7e8a4ca90], the functional availability was compromised by an "Fs end of file" error during repository access [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 6e575467-887b-404d-9c4c-1020fefc98bf], rendering the FMS non-operational.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Data Integrity Audit**: Perform a full checksum validation and integrity check on the "Public FMS Artifact" files across all nodes to resolve the "Fs end of file" error [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 6e575467-887b-404d-9c4c-1020fefc98bf].
2. **Library Reinstallation**: Conduct a targeted reinstallation and verification of the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library on NODE_A to address the OSS loading failure [Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: 3c329e54-f356-4e15-a945-2c15ff4b4e39].
3. **Configuration Management Review**: Investigate the FMS configuration synchronization protocol to determine why an operator interaction on NODE_C resulted in a widespread data integrity mismatch.

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:00:05 | NODE_B | 15 | CRITICAL |

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involved a rapid, cascading failure of the Flight Management System (FMS) services on NODE_B following an FMS Service Restart. The failure progressed from a process identity error to a total inability to load critical system libraries and access the FMS Data Repository, resulting in a non-functional FMS state despite the module reporting an "Operational" status.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a failure during an **FMS Service Restart** `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 6e8e270e-6b96-4173-ad7b-d7cc09089573]`. The failure mechanism initiated as a **Background Service Identity Failure (Code: 6025)**, specifically characterized by the system's inability to "get current process id" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 6e8e270e-6b96-4173-ad7b-d7cc09089573]`. This suggests a fundamental breakdown in the Operating System (OSS) ability to manage process handles during the service initialization phase.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1.  **Process Identity Failure:** NODE_B failed to retrieve the current process ID during the service restart `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 6e8e270e-6b96-4173-ad7b-d7cc09089573]`.
2.  **Data Repository Access Failure:** The system attempted to access the Public FMS Artifact file but encountered an "Fs end of file" error `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 80f246cd-a074-4be1-b63a-8186938b2fbf]`.
3.  **Critical Library Loading Failure:** The OSS failed to load the essential `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: cdbbe0ca-8f40-4655-9918-610d484eb1b4]`.
4.  **Task Management Collapse:** The failure propagated to the task management layer, resulting in "Process is not found" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 29 | UUID: ed7b4152-15fe-4944-aebb-3240d9ac4667]`, "Client Cb not found" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 37 | UUID: 646b62d5-231b-4852-88f1-d8e178bc531b]`, and "Task Client not found" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 45 | UUID: d2374a60-77bf-47a7-bb7b-ef96625836bf]` errors.
5.  **System Initialization Failure:** The cascade concluded with a terminal "Error during start process" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 48 | UUID: 16c30466-9073-4d98-a167-81891b6630c7]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
*   **Redundancy Loss:** NODE_B has experienced a total loss of FMS functional capability.
*   **Degraded Flight Management Modes:** While the module state is technically "Operational" `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 6e8e270e-6b96-4173-ad7b-d7cc09089573]`, the inability to load the FMS Data Repository and critical SSL libraries means the node cannot participate in active flight management, forcing the aircraft into a degraded single-node FMS mode.
*   **Functional Availability:** FMS availability on NODE_B is currently zero due to the failure of the background service identity and task client management.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1.  **File System Integrity Audit:** Perform a comprehensive diagnostic of the FMS Data Repository to identify and repair the cause of the "Fs end of file" error `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 3 | UUID: 80f246cd-a074-4be1-b63a-8186938b2fbf]`.
2.  **Library Integrity Verification:** Conduct a checksum verification and re-installation of the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library to resolve the loading failure `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 25 | UUID: cdbbe0ca-8f40-4655-9918-610d484eb1b4]`.
3.  **FMS Service Restart Logic Review:** Engineering must investigate the FMS Service Restart sequence to determine why the system fails to retrieve process IDs during the initialization context `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 6e8e270e-6b96-4173-ad7b-d7cc09089573]`.

This triggered a rapid cascade of service identity failures and library loading errors, resulting in the loss of system redundancy and a transition from Dual mode to Single mode.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-b2144b17

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 09:41:22 to 09:47:53 | NODE_A, NODE_B, NODE_C | 394 | **CRITICAL** |

## 2. Executive Summary
A critical failure occurred on NODE_A initiated by a file system error within the FMS Data Repository. This triggered a rapid cascade of service identity failures and library loading errors, resulting in the loss of system redundancy and a transition from Dual mode to Single mode.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a File System (FS) error occurring during an attempt to access the FMS Data Repository. Specifically, the system encountered an "end of file" error when attempting to retrieve the "Public FMS Artifact" file `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 79 | UUID: 1da8c3a3-b6d3-4ce5-81ef-90002e1ea1ed]`. This corruption or truncation prevented the FMS service from successfully establishing its identity and process environment, as evidenced by the immediate "get current process id failure 653" `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: 6dce8c5b-0bb7-426b-8a8f-92c18af0decb]`.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **09:41:22:** FMS Data Repository access failure occurs due to an FS end-of-file error in the Public FMS Artifact file `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 79 | UUID: 1da8c3a3-b6d3-4ce5-81ef-90002e1ea1ed]`.
2. **09:41:22:** Background Service Identity Failure (Code 6025) is triggered because the system cannot retrieve the current process ID `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 77 | UUID: 6dce8c5b-0bb7-426b-8a8f-92c18af0decb]`.
3. **09:41:23:** A critical OS loading failure (Code 6052) occurs when the DEOS environment fails to load the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 101 | UUID: 2c2c92a2-01f0-4df1-928b-55479b6b8de7]`.
4. **09:41:24:** The Control Plane Database (CPDB) fails to enable (Code 6) `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 104 | UUID: 0e3eb7d5-e164-4317-874b-57442b75f511]`.
5. **09:41:24:** Redundancy is lost as the system transitions from Dual mode to Single mode `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 8650d422-8f5f-4de5-b020-46d170527e23]`.
6. **09:41:25:** Total collapse of Operating System Services (OSS) occurs, characterized by bind failures (Code 6035) `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 114 | UUID: 057b8a98-8d78-436b-bb80-b0bf64c61e44]` and task client failures (Code 6024) `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 122 | UUID: a471668d-986d-4c0d-ad54-5b553bfd179c]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Loss:** The system suffered a critical loss of redundancy, regressing from Dual mode to Single mode `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 1 | UUID: 8650d422-8f5f-4de5-b020-46d170527e23]`.
* **Functional Availability:** NODE_A experienced a near-total loss of FMS functionality due to the inability to load essential libraries and initialize background services.
* **Operational State:** The FMS service underwent multiple restarts attempting to recover, but failed to reach a stable state due to the persistent file system error.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Data Integrity Audit:** Perform a comprehensive checksum validation and integrity check of the FMS Data Repository, with specific focus on the "Public FMS Artifact" file to identify and repair corruption.
2. **Hardware Storage Inspection:** Conduct a diagnostic test of the non-volatile memory (NVM) on NODE_A to rule out physical sector degradation or hardware-level file system errors.
3. **Software/Library Verification:** Re-verify the integrity of the DEOS library directory, specifically ensuring the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` file is present and uncorrupted.

## 1. Incident Overview

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involved a rapid sequence of flight management system (FMS) operator interactions involving offset data and temporary flight plan insertions, which culminated in a distributed hardware/software fault. The event resulted in an RNP (Required Navigation Performance) legs transmitter I/O failure on the Master node and a subsequent integrity validation timeout on the standby/redundant node.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a high-frequency sequence of **Operator Interactions** involving the initialization of offset data `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 90 | UUID: e0f03f7f-7b97-4b98-8d2d-a1a2444c20b2]` and the insertion of temporary flight plan data `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 99 | UUID: f4b1e8bc-7f93-4f3b-9f5d-06ba03fefe6e]`. 

The failure mechanism appears to be a resource exhaustion or data bus contention issue caused by simultaneous or near-simultaneous command entries from both the Captain (NODE_A) and First Officer (NODE_C) positions `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 92 | UUID: 6a9c784f-5771-4709-a0f6-5ec48bfbf8c5]`. This rapid state transition from "Offset Initialization" to "Temporary Insertion" and "Optimized Step Selection" created a processing load that triggered an I/O fault in the RNP legs transmitter.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Command Initiation:** NODE_A (Captain) initiates offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 90 | UUID: e0f03f7f-7b97-4b98-8d2d-a1a2444c20b2]`.
2. **Cross-Node Synchronization:** NODE_C (First Officer) simultaneously processes offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 92 | UUID: 6a9c784f-5771-4709-a0f6-5ec48bfbf8c5]`.
3. **Data Modification:** Rapid succession of "Enter Offset Distance" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 93 | UUID: 853e5b9f-aa2f-431b-825b-2d731b7a8c21]` and "Insert Temporary" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 99 | UUID: f4b1e8bc-7f93-4f3b-9f5d-06ba03fefe6e]` commands are issued.
4. **Primary Node Fault:** At 09:50:50, NODE_A experiences an "Rnp legs transmitter io" fault (Code 6, Sub Code 93) `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 168 | UUID: 135818ed-fed2-406f-93ea-ee8eb69d96c0]`.
5. **Redundancy Failure:** At 09:50:52, the failure propagates to NODE_B, which reports an "Rnp integrity validation receiver timeout" (Code 6, Sub Code 97) `[Source: NODE_B_FAULT_HISTORY_LOG | Seq: 133 | UUID: UNKNOWN_B_LOG_REF]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Loss:** The system transitioned from a Dual-mode operational state to a state of degraded redundancy. The failure of the RNP legs transmitter on the Master node (NODE_A) `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 168 | UUID: 135818ed-fed2-406f-93ea-ee8eb69d96c0]` followed by a timeout on NODE_B indicates a loss of cross-channel integrity.
* **Degraded Flight Management:** The ability to perform RNP-based navigation is compromised due to the I/O fault and the subsequent integrity validation timeout.
* **Functional Availability:** While the FMS modules remain "Operational" in terms of power/state, the specific RNP functional capability is unavailable.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Bus Load Analysis:** Conduct a high-fidelity bus traffic analysis on the avionics data bus to determine if the simultaneous input from NODE_A and NODE_C exceeded the interrupt handling capacity of the RNP legs transmitter.
2. **Software Logic Review:** Evaluate the FMS software handling of "Temporary Efb" flight plan sources `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 99 | UUID: f4b1e8bc-7f93-4f3b-9f5d-06ba03fefe6e]` to ensure that rapid state transitions do not cause race conditions in the I/O driver.
3. **Hardware Inspection:** Perform a physical inspection and diagnostic test of the RNP legs transmitter hardware on NODE_A to rule out intermittent electrical connectivity issues that may have been exacerbated by high data throughput.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-c6c93874

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:00:00 | NODE_A | 1 | **CRITICAL** |

## 2. Executive Summary
A critical software exception occurred on NODE_A during a routine aircraft state update, resulting in immediate corruption of the flight management data vector. The incident was characterized by the presence of a software fault address and physically impossible flight parameters (e.g., invalid track and cost index), indicating a catastrophic failure of the state buffer integrity.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger for this incident was a specific user interaction via the Integrated On-board Control Interface (IOCI), identified by the `Ioci button push: 436207617` [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc]. 

This interaction appears to have triggered an illegal memory access or an unhandled exception, as evidenced by the immediate recording of a `Software fault address: 1610612737` [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc]. The failure mechanism is consistent with a pointer error or a stack overflow occurring during the processing of the IOCI input, which subsequently corrupted the adjacent memory space containing the aircraft state variables.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence

1.  **Trigger Event:** An IOCI button press is registered by the system [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc].
2.  **Exception Execution:** The system attempts to process the input, resulting in a software fault at address `1610612737` [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc].
3.  **Data Corruption (State Vector):** The fault propagates to the aircraft state buffer, causing immediate corruption of critical flight parameters:
    *   **Track Corruption:** The track value is recorded as `785.082153`, a value exceeding the physical limit of 360 degrees [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc].
    *   **Cost Index Corruption:** The Cost Index is corrupted to an unrealistic `201326657` [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc].
    *   **Sequence Underflow:** The `Next lateral leg Sequence` undergoes an integer underflow/error, resulting in a negative value of `-1935671229` [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 9 | UUID: bc88b378-0589-429d-8ac8-e126bef0c2bc].

## 5. System Impact Assessment
*   **Redundancy Loss:** NODE_A has suffered a total loss of data integrity for the current flight state.
*   **Degraded Flight Management:** The FMS is unable to calculate valid lateral or vertical paths due to the corrupted `Next lateral leg Sequence` and `Track` values. The system has likely transitioned from Full Automation to a failed state or a degraded manual navigation mode.
*   **Functional Availability:** Critical navigation functions (NDB, ILS) are operating with corrupted state data, rendering the current flight plan unreliable.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions

1.  **Software Engineering (Immediate):** Conduct a deep-dive memory audit of the IOCI interrupt service routine (ISR) to identify the cause of the software fault at address `1610612737`. Implement strict bounds checking on all IOCI-triggered state transitions.
2.  **Software Engineering (Validation):** Implement "Sanity Check" logic within the Aircraft State Update loop to detect and reject physically impossible values (e.g., Track > 360 or negative Sequence numbers) before they are committed to the primary state buffer.
3.  **Hardware Inspection:** Perform a physical inspection of the IOCI hardware interface and the NODE_A processing unit to ensure no electrical transients or hardware-level bit-flips are contributing to the memory corruption.

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |

| 2032-06-18 | 09:55:37 - 09:57:37 | NODE_A, NODE_C | 124 | CRITICAL |

## 2. Executive Summary
During the transition to arrival procedures, a series of rapid FMS state changes and flight plan modifications triggered a critical I/O failure on the Master FMS node (NODE_A). The incident culminated in an RNP legs transmitter I/O fault, necessitating an FMS service restart to attempt recovery.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a high-frequency sequence of operator-initiated state transitions, specifically the entry of arrival procedures `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 114 | UUID: 2be04fed-d6d6-4506-ad9a-8f7b12d3d4c1]` followed immediately by the erasure of temporary flight plan data `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 118 | UUID: ee8550a2-5f86-4571-914f-eed82e993667]`. This rapid succession of data writes and deletions during the synchronization of the Dual mode system likely induced an I/O bus instability or a race condition within the RNP legs transmitter interface.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Arrival Procedure Initiation:** The operator initiated arrival procedures on NODE_A (Captain/Master) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 114 | UUID: 2be04fed-d6d6-4506-ad9a-8f7b12d3d4c1]` and NODE_C (First Officer/Spare) `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 116 | UUID: 04e114fd-b210-481c-b855-a39a5b9429e0]`.
2. **Performance Data Synchronization:** Performance data updates were propagated across the nodes `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 116 | UUID: ce3918cc-54c5-421a-acb2-08b03591937b]`.
3. **Temporary Data Erasure:** Both nodes executed an "erase temporary" command on the flight plan `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 118 | UUID: ee8550a2-5f86-4571-914f-eed82e993667]` and `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 120 | UUID: f253bec5-3f5a-4dc1-b49c-32714342fb1f]`.
4. **Origin Runway Entry:** The operator entered the origin runway (Ifse), triggering further performance data changes `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 121 | UUID: b0dac446-2ed1-4f12-a2c9-28ed9b2191ae]`.
5. **I/O Fault Occurrence:** The cumulative stress of these transitions resulted in a "Rnp legs transmitter io" fault (Code 6, Sub Code 93) on NODE_A `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 175 | UUID: 26f97150-44d2-4aac-9b52-181af1397315]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
The system experienced a critical loss of functional integrity on the Master FMS node (NODE_A) due to the RNP legs transmitter I/O error `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 175 | UUID: 26f97150-44d2-4aac-9b52-181af1397315]`. While the system was operating in "Dual" mode, the fault on the Master node indicates a significant degradation of primary flight management capabilities and a loss of redundancy for RNP-related functions.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Hardware Inspection:** Perform a comprehensive physical inspection and signal integrity test of the RNP legs transmitter I/O interface and associated wiring for Member System Equipment Identifier 540 `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 175 | UUID: 26f97150-44d2-4aac-9b52-181af1397315]`.
2. **Software Diagnostic:** Conduct a deep-dive analysis of the FMS software logic to determine if rapid "erase temporary" and "enter arrival" command sequences can trigger buffer overflows or I/O timeouts in the RNP module.
3. **Service Log Review:** Audit all recent "FMS Service Restart" events to determine if this fault is an isolated hardware failure or a recurring software-induced reset.

root_cause: The primary trigger is identified as a software-level memory corruption or integer overflow event affecting the `Cruise altitude` variable [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 10 | UUID: 8454d904-caba-42dd-902b-d259348785f8]. cascade_sequence:
1. **Initial Corruption Detection:** At 09:56:10, NODE_A reported a highly anomalous cruise altitude of 2147483648.000000 and an initial software fault address of 33557728 [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 10 | UUID: 8454d904-caba-42dd-902b-d259348785f8].
2. **State Transition & Escalation:** During the next state update at 09:57:05, the cruise altitude value escalated to 34359738368.000000 [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 11 | UUID: e805937a-8e38-4df6-961c-cefc1aa14a2c].
3. **Fault Address Shift:** Simultaneously with the altitude escalation, the software fault address shifted from 33557728 to 402656480 [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 11 | UUID: e805937a-8e38-4df6-961c-cefc1aa14a2c].
4. **Fault Persistence:** By 09:57:22, the system stabilized in a corrupted state, maintaining the erroneous altitude of 34359738368.000000 and the fault address of 402656480 [Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 12 | UUID: 5256da1d-94c0-4e3b-a5e4-1809803e2f12].

root_cause:
The primary trigger is identified as a software execution fault within the Flight Management System (FMS) logic of NODE_A. Initial telemetry at 10:08:47 recorded a software fault at address `17170434` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 16 | UUID: 4a5eff99-2cea-4acf-9c2a-5e303c11fabc]`. 

The failure mechanism is suspected to be a pointer corruption or buffer overflow. This is evidenced by the fact that at 10:09:18, the `Software fault address` jumped to `4278583298` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 97a66de2-9421-4a7c-8096-cbecc0a5c476]`, which is identical to the value recorded in the `Ioci button push` register `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 97a66de2-9421-4a7c-8096-cbecc0a5c476]`. This direct correlation suggests that a pilot input or interface command was incorrectly processed as a memory address, leading to an illegal instruction jump.
cascade_sequence:
1. **Initial Fault Detection:** NODE_A registers a software fault at memory address `17170434` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 16 | UUID: 4a5eff99-2cea-4acf-9c2a-5e303c11fabc]`.
2. **State Instability:** The system continues to update aircraft state, but the software environment becomes unstable.
3. **Input-Driven Corruption:** An IOCI (Input/Output Control Interface) event occurs, where the input value `4278583298` is injected into the processing stream `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 97a66de2-9421-4a7c-8096-cbecc0a5c476]`.
4. **Critical Execution Failure:** The processor attempts to execute at the corrupted address, resulting in a secondary, high-magnitude software fault at `4278583298` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 97a66de2-9421-4a7c-8096-cbecc0a5c476]`.
system_impact:
* **Redundancy Loss:** The failure is isolated to NODE_A; however, the nature of the fault (memory corruption) poses a risk of common-mode failure if the same input is processed by a redundant node.
* **Functional Availability:** The FMS integrity is compromised. While lateral leg sequences were being tracked (e.g., Sequence `1409225282`), the software fault indicates that the computational validity of these sequences can no longer be guaranteed `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 17 | UUID: 97a66de2-9421-4a7c-8096-cbecc0a5c476]`.
* **Degraded Modes:** The system has transitioned from a nominal state to a critical fault state, necessitating immediate pilot intervention or automated reversion to secondary navigation modes.
corrective_actions:
1. **Software Patch (High Priority):** Implement strict input validation and sanitization within the IOCI driver to prevent user-interface button push indices from being interpreted as memory pointers or addresses.
2. **Memory Dump Analysis:** Conduct a full forensic dump of the NODE_A volatile memory to identify the specific instruction set that allowed the `Ioci button push` value to overwrite the software fault register.
3. **Hardware Integrity Audit:** Perform a diagnostic check on the FMS processing unit to ensure no physical degradation of the RAM or bus architecture contributed to the address jump.

Specifically, the Captain (NODE_A, Master) initiated an offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 290 | UUID: 60403dfa-dd3a-4714-a2ed-a6c45ffb547a]` followed immediately by the First Officer (NODE_C, Spare) initiating an identical offset initialization `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 292 | UUID: a560cbf3-ddae-43cd-b234-cf43a0583202]`. This indicates a failure in the system's ability to arbitrate simultaneous write-access requests to the shared flight plan state.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **[10:18:27]** NODE_A (Master/Captain) initiates offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 290 | UUID: 60403dfa-dd3a-4714-a2ed-a6c45ffb547a]`.
2. **[10:18:28]** NODE_C (Spare/First Officer) simultaneously initiates offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 292 | UUID: a560cbf3-ddae-43cd-b234-cf43a0583202]`.
3. **[10:18:30 - 10:18:32]** The failure propagates as both nodes attempt to process waypoint and performance data changes independently; NODE_A enters an offset start waypoint `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 293 | UUID: deb379e7-8ce8-4094-8e33-f5b8035d51b6]` while NODE_C simultaneously enters the same waypoint `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 295 | UUID: 3ea294ea-271e-43c5-9771-8aaa982160ea]`.
4. **[10:18:39 - 10:18:41]** The conflict escalates to flight plan source modifications, where both nodes attempt to insert temporary data from an Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 300 | UUID: d29634eb-eb9c-4a46-9938-924fb6bda2ab]` and `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 302 | UUID: 3b7948f1-450a-4f35-b147-0f017b3066af]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
The incident resulted in a significant degradation of the FMS redundancy architecture. While the system remained in "Dual" mode, the functional distinction between the "Master" and "Spare" nodes was compromised, as the Spare node (NODE_C) actively accepted and processed high-level flight plan modifications `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 293 | UUID: e715fe47-f623-4000-8ef9-2fbe69a66ff7]`. This creates a "split-brain" risk where the Master and Spare nodes may hold divergent flight plan data, potentially leading to incorrect navigation guidance if a master-to-spare transition occurs.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Software Logic Update (Critical):** Implement a mandatory write-lock arbitration protocol. The FMS software must be patched to ensure that if a "Master" node is in an active "Operator Interaction" state for flight plan modification, all "Spare" nodes are programmatically inhibited from accepting write-commands for the same data identifiers.
2. **FMS State Transition Audit:** Conduct a comprehensive review of the state machine logic governing the transition between "Master," "Standby," and "Spare" roles to ensure that "Spare" nodes cannot be elevated to an active modification state via local operator interaction without a formal master-handover command.
3. **Bus Traffic Analysis:** Perform a high-fidelity inspection of the data bus communication between NODE_A and NODE_C to ensure that concurrent command packets are not being misinterpreted or incorrectly prioritized by the distributed avionics controller.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-58a65ec2

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:00:00 | NODE_A | 1 | CRITICAL |

## 2. Executive Summary
A critical software fault occurred within the Flight Management System (FMS) logic of NODE_A, resulting in an immediate system exception. The incident was characterized by a memory-level fault at a specific software address during a high-frequency sequence of pilot/FMS interface interactions.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger for this incident is a **Software Fault** occurring at memory address `536870913` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`. 

The failure mechanism is linked to an overflow or invalid pointer dereference within the FMS processing logic. This is evidenced by the highly irregular state of the lateral leg sequences, where the `Current lateral leg Sequence` is recorded as `1409374274` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`, while the `Next lateral leg Sequence` is a negative integer `-1935671229` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`. This integer underflow/wrap-around in the sequence logic likely triggered the software fault address.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Input Saturation:** The system processed a massive burst of FMS button pushes (indices ranging from `333312` to `2550136832`) `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`.
2. **Sequence Logic Corruption:** The lateral leg sequence calculation resulted in a non-monotonic transition, moving from a large positive sequence to a negative sequence `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`.
3. **Memory Exception:** The invalid sequence state caused the FMS software to attempt an operation at an illegal memory location, specifically `Software fault address: 536870913` `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`.
4. **Node Halt:** The fault resulted in an immediate state update termination for NODE_A.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Loss:** NODE_A has experienced a total functional failure of its FMS processing capabilities.
* **Degraded Flight Management:** The aircraft has lost the ability to process lateral navigation updates via this node, potentially forcing a reversion to Single Mode or manual navigation depending on the status of secondary FMS nodes.
* **Functional Availability:** Critical navigation parameters, including Track (`13.269106`) and Cruise Altitude (`34359738368.000000`), are frozen at the moment of the fault `[Source: NODE_A_Aircraft_State_Buffer_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 22 | UUID: 77ebff63-25fb-4a90-aa48-3b97481f0a0d]`.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Software Patch (Immediate):** Perform a code audit of the lateral leg sequence increment/decrement logic to implement bounds checking and prevent integer wrap-around/underflow.
2. **Memory Integrity Check:** Conduct a full diagnostic of the NODE_A memory modules to ensure the fault address `536870913` is not indicative of a physical hardware bit-flip or ECC failure.
3. **FMS Input Buffer Stress Test:** Implement high-frequency input testing in a simulated environment to ensure the CDU (Control Display Unit) scratchpad and button push processing can handle rapid-fire inputs without causing state corruption.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a high-density sequence of **Operator Interactions** involving state transitions and performance data updates `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 332 | UUID: 28785378-9651-4404-ae2e-6d48633be976]`. Specifically, the transition from entering the origin runway (Ifse) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 329 | UUID: eb7b21a8-3a94-4722-a797-c7d6b32bd8bf]` to entering a departure procedure (Anek3d) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 335 | UUID: b5d7494b-b3ef-4b91-a782-cdd399cf80dc]` and subsequent offset data initialization `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 340 | UUID: 05f6fb23-9330-4b3a-b7bc-ee24949b3930]` created a computational load that exceeded the FMS scheduled task window. This culminated in a "Scheduled FMS Activity Missed Timing Requirement" (Fault 6000) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 185]`.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Initial State Change:** Operator enters origin runway (Ifse) on NODE_A (Master) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 329 | UUID: eb7b21a8-3a94-4722-a797-c7d6b32bd8bf]`.

3. **Operational Load Increase:** Operator selects optimized step and enters departure procedure (Anek3d) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 334 | UUID: 370613ed-db24-4a0a-9215-849f80fb0db]`.

executive_summary: The investigation identified a critical failure in the Flight Management System (FMS) during an operational cold startup, characterized by a cascading software library loading failure. The incident resulted in the loss of dual-mode redundancy, forcing the system into a degraded "Single" mode with the Captain's functional position reporting "No displayable fields" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 345 | UUID: 796180cb-08f7-44be-bbdb-fee8452331b6]`.
root_cause: The primary trigger was an **FMS Service Restart** leading to an **Operational startup cold** `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 129 | UUID: 3bef60ed-9657-41d2-a54c-2d4773d7a886]`. This restart initiated a sequence of failed service identity checks and library dependencies. Specifically, the system failed to execute `get current process id` during the initialization phase `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 188 | UUID: 705c696c-cac8-4546-a19d-b26bb6acc860]`, which prevented the subsequent loading of critical OS components.
cascade_sequence:
1.  **Service Identity Failure:** NODE_A experienced multiple "Background Service Identity Failures" (Code: 6025) due to an inability to retrieve process IDs `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 190 | UUID: a27bd551-ee92-4f42-a5e8-c46ce7eac40d]`.
2.  **Library Loading Failure:** The failure to identify services led to an "Oss loading failure" (Code: 6052), specifically failing to load the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library in the Deos environment `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 192 | UUID: 3861c8c0-c4b4-4d03-ac25-fd2aac6ded21]`.
3.  **Cross-Node Propagation:** The library loading failure propagated to NODE_C, which also reported an "Oss loading failure" (Code: 6052) for the same library `[Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 208 | UUID: b4dd0755-c942-4cf0-924f-389feb76ea1e]`.
4.  **Task Client Collapse:** Following the library failure, NODE_A reported multiple "Oss task client failure" (Code: 6024) events, indicating that the OS could no longer locate required task clients `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 204 | UUID: 9879a038-dfd1-4821-bd6f-808c78b396ae]`.
5.  **Redundancy Loss:** The system transitioned from a dual-mode state to a "Single" mode, with the left FMS node designated as "Spare" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 130 | UUID: 95f87776-7f24-4f46-8e26-673d55f6683e]`.
system_impact:
*   **Redundancy Loss:** Total loss of dual-mode FMS capability. The system reverted to "Single" mode `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 130 | UUID: 95f87776-7f24-4f46-8e26-673d55f6683e]`.
*   **Degraded Flight Management:** The Captain's functional position experienced a critical display failure, reporting "No displayable fields" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 345 | UUID: 796180cb-08f7-44be-bbdb-fee8452331b6]`.
*   **Functional Availability:** While the module state remained "Operational," the functional availability was severely compromised due to the inability to bind OS clients and load necessary SSL/DTF management libraries.
corrective_actions:
1.  **Software Integrity Audit:** Perform a checksum verification of the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library across all FMS nodes to identify potential file corruption or incomplete deployment.
2.  **OS Environment Re-image:** Conduct a full re-installation of the Deos operating system on NODE_A and NODE_C to resolve the "get current process id" and "Oss bind failure" errors.
3.  **Bus/Data Integrity Check:** Inspect the communication bus for any intermittent signal issues that may have caused the "Cpdb opc not enabled" and "Ndb out of date" errors during the initialization sequence.

## 2. Executive Summary
The investigation identified a critical failure in the Flight Management System (FMS) during an operational cold startup, characterized by a cascading software library loading failure. The incident resulted in the loss of dual-mode redundancy, forcing the system into a degraded "Single" mode with the Captain's functional position reporting "No displayable fields" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 345 | UUID: 796180cb-08f7-44be-bbdb-fee8452331b6]`.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was an **FMS Service Restart** leading to an **Operational startup cold** `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 129 | UUID: 3bef60ed-9657-41d2-a54c-2d4773d7a886]`. This restart initiated a sequence of failed service identity checks and library dependencies. Specifically, the system failed to execute `get current process id` during the initialization phase `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 188 | UUID: 705c696c-cac8-4546-a19d-b26bb6acc860]`, which prevented the subsequent loading of critical OS components.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1.  **Service Identity Failure:** NODE_A experienced multiple "Background Service Identity Failures" (Code: 6025) due to an inability to retrieve process IDs `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 190 | UUID: a27bd551-ee92-4f42-a5e8-c46ce7eac40d]`.
2.  **Library Loading Failure:** The failure to identify services led to an "Oss loading failure" (Code: 6052), specifically failing to load the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library in the Deos environment `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 192 | UUID: 3861c8c0-c4b4-4d03-ac25-fd2aac6ded21]`.
3.  **Cross-Node Propagation:** The library loading failure propagated to NODE_C, which also reported an "Oss loading failure" (Code: 6052) for the same library `[Source: NODE_C_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 208 | UUID: b4dd0755-c942-4cf0-924f-389feb76ea1e]`.
4.  **Task Client Collapse:** Following the library failure, NODE_A reported multiple "Oss task client failure" (Code: 6024) events, indicating that the OS could no longer locate required task clients `[Source: NODE_A_FAULT_REPOSITORY_01_1_Decoded_report.html | Seq: 204 | UUID: 9879a038-dfd1-4821-bd6f-808c78b396ae]`.
5.  **Redundancy Loss:** The system transitioned from a dual-mode state to a "Single" mode, with the left FMS node designated as "Spare" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 130 | UUID: 95f87776-7f24-4f46-8e26-673d55f6683e]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
*   **Redundancy Loss:** Total loss of dual-mode FMS capability. The system reverted to "Single" mode `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 130 | UUID: 95f87776-7f24-4f46-8e26-673d55f6683e]`.
*   **Degraded Flight Management:** The Captain's functional position experienced a critical display failure, reporting "No displayable fields" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 345 | UUID: 796180cb-08f7-44be-bbdb-fee8452331b6]`.
*   **Functional Availability:** While the module state remained "Operational," the functional availability was severely compromised due to the inability to bind OS clients and load necessary SSL/DTF management libraries.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1.  **Software Integrity Audit:** Perform a checksum verification of the `Libpssl dtf manager so.so` library across all FMS nodes to identify potential file corruption or incomplete deployment.
2.  **OS Environment Re-image:** Conduct a full re-installation of the Deos operating system on NODE_A and NODE_C to resolve the "get current process id" and "Oss bind failure" errors.
3.  **Bus/Data Integrity Check:** Inspect the communication bus for any intermittent signal issues that may have caused the "Cpdb opc not enabled" and "Ndb out of date" errors during the initialization sequence.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-df9f84e3

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:01:21 | NODE_A, NODE_C | 72 | WARNING |

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involved a high-frequency sequence of flight management system (FMS) updates initiated by simultaneous operator interactions on both the Master (Captain) and Spare (First Officer) nodes. While the system maintained Dual mode throughout the event, the rapid succession of destination changes, temporary flight plan insertions, and approach entries created a period of intense data bus activity and performance data recalculations.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a concurrent operator interaction event where both the Captain (NODE_A) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 405 | UUID: a73e5dd1-3274-488a-b48d-76355f24a6fd]` and the First Officer (NODE_C) `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 409 | UUID: d749b26f-ba4b-48a1-9e82-40d92991633a]` entered a "new destination" string (Endu) within one second of each other. This triggered a race condition in the distributed FMS state synchronization, leading to a rapid cascade of performance data updates and flight plan source transitions.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Initial Input:** NODE_A (Captain) initiated a "new destination" command `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 405 | UUID: a73e5dd1-3274-488a-b48d-76355f24a6fd]`.
2. **Concurrent Input:** NODE_C (First Officer) simultaneously entered the same "new destination" command `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 409 | UUID: d749b26f-ba4b-48a1-9e82-40d92991633a]`.
3. **Performance Recalculation:** Both nodes registered immediate "Performance Data Changed" events `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 408 | UUID: b453486d-0ec3-492b-99bb-ee1f4b9808d4]`.
4. **Flight Plan Transition:** The flight plan source transitioned from "ActPrimary" to "TmpyPrimary" via a "temporary insert" command on both nodes `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 410 | UUID: a7c878b5-0a03-40bd-b115-c1f48dc067a9]`.
5. **State Propagation:** NODE_A selected an "Optimized Step" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 412 | UUID: 518f9375-c97d-4d0f-8308-cec653ab8d27]`, which was subsequently mirrored/processed by NODE_C `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 416 | UUID: 22e8438d-89ed-421e-8f98-1cf61b1a82f6]`.
6. **Approach Entry:** The sequence concluded with both nodes executing the "enter approach" command `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 415 | UUID: b893fb5e-d143-45bb-840b-6287337aba11]` and `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 419 | UUID: f44349ab-205a-4af3-b14a-6003b62d9814]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Status:** The system successfully maintained "Dual" mode throughout the entire event duration `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 160 | UUID: 49a98d18-b50b-439a-923e-b11d05f4e545]`.
* **Functional Availability:** Flight Management functionality remained available, but the system experienced high-frequency state transitions, specifically regarding performance data updates `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 413 | UUID: 00c3cc77-9bbd-4caf-aa0d-2d5387799c16]`.
* **Degradation:** No loss of primary flight modes was observed, though the rapid-fire input sequence suggests a high workload on the FMS data bus.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **Software Logic Update:** Implement an input arbitration protocol to handle near-simultaneous operator commands on Master and Spare nodes to prevent redundant performance recalculation cycles.
2. **Bus Load Analysis:** Conduct a high-fidelity bus traffic analysis to ensure that rapid-fire "Performance Data Changed" events do not exceed the maximum allowable latency for critical FMS updates.
3. **Operator Training Review:** Evaluate cockpit coordination procedures regarding simultaneous FMS data entry to minimize the risk of concurrent state-change triggers.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-e12cd319

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:00:06 | NODE_A, NODE_C | 15 | WARNING |

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involved a period of rapid state transitions within the Flight Management System (FMS) triggered by concurrent Navigation Database Refresh Cycles on both the Master (NODE_A) and Spare (NODE_C) nodes. While the system maintained Dual mode operational status, the simultaneous refresh activity caused oscillating vertical guidance sequences and optimized step selections across the distributed architecture.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was an **Operator Interaction** initiating a **Navigation Database Refresh Cycle** on the Master FMS node (NODE_A) `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 441 | UUID: 963eadde-2b79-4901-b262-2ff44f8beb69]`. 

The failure mechanism is identified as a **concurrent refresh synchronization conflict**. Shortly after the Master node initiated its cycle, the Spare node (NODE_C) also entered a Navigation Database Refresh Cycle `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 445 | UUID: 7c684f4e-f0ca-4745-9ed4-7bbea48b5f9c]`. This simultaneous processing of database updates across the distributed nodes appears to have caused transient instability in the LNAV and Vertical Guidance state machines.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence

1.  **Initial Trigger:** NODE_A (Captain/Master) initiates a Navigation Database Refresh Cycle `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 441 | UUID: 963eadde-2b79-4901-b262-2ff44f8beb69]`.
2.  **Master State Change:** NODE_A processes an "Optimized Step Selected" operational event `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 442 | UUID: 5b2994d5-37fa-4617-b9ab-36110fcb589e]`.
3.  **Concurrent Trigger:** NODE_C (First Officer/Spare) initiates a secondary Navigation Database Refresh Cycle `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 445 | UUID: 7c684f4e-f0ca-4745-9ed4-7bbea48b5f9c]`.
4.  **Cross-Node Propagation:** NODE_C reports an "Optimized Step Selected" event, but the data source is identified as the Captain (Master) node, indicating data synchronization during the refresh `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 446 | UUID: 5f63621c-ad96-4e3b-aa06-c4351bb1dfc2]`.
5.  **Guidance Instability:** Rapid changes in the Vertical Guidance Sequence are observed on NODE_C `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 447 | UUID: 45751506-9c1c-49ba-aa04-4e12f69bf289]` and subsequently on NODE_A `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 445 | UUID: ad9029db-2bfb-4c1f-8857-a655d5d6810c]`.
6.  **Cycle Persistence:** NODE_C undergoes a subsequent refresh cycle attempt at 10:49:50 `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 448 | UUID: ef1fba85-c16d-470c-bf6e-5a96107f29a8]`, continuing the state oscillation.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
*   **Redundancy Loss:** None. The system successfully maintained **Dual mode** throughout the event `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 171 | UUID: 7df51f9e-23da-4d84-a07e-2d3dc11b8e91]`.
*   **Degraded Flight Management Modes:** The system remained in Dual mode, but functional availability of vertical guidance was intermittently unstable due to rapid "Vertical Guidance Sequence Changed" events `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 449 | UUID: cf6bde36-92a4-4cff-b5ea-9364d93047d7]`.
*   **Functional Availability:** LNAV status remained at "L navigation hdg" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_LBPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 172 | UUID: 98b451fd-fa1e-488d-b1d4-360f50b33022]`, suggesting that while guidance sequences were changing, the fundamental navigation mode was preserved.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1.  **Software Logic Update:** Implement a software interlock to prevent the initiation of a Navigation Database Refresh Cycle on a Spare/Standby node while a Master node is currently executing a refresh cycle.
2.  **Bus Traffic Analysis:** Conduct a high-fidelity inspection of the communication bus between NODE_A and NODE_C to ensure that rapid state changes during database updates do not exceed the expected data frame timing requirements.
3.  **FMS Operational Procedure Review:** Update Flight Crew Operating Manuals (FCOM) to mandate that database refreshes be performed sequentially rather than concurrently across multiple FMS nodes to prevent synchronization transients.

# AVIATION FORENSIC INVESTIGATION REPORT: cluster-0b0c7268

## 1. Incident Overview

| Date | Duration | Affected Nodes | Total Events | Severity Rating |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2032-06-18 | 00:02:04 | NODE_A, NODE_C | 55 | WARNING |

## 2. Executive Summary
The incident involved a high-density sequence of Flight Management System (FMS) updates initiated by near-simultaneous operator interactions on both the Master (NODE_A) and Spare (NODE_C) nodes. The event sequence progressed from cruise flight entry and performance parameter modification to a final transition of the flight plan source to a temporary Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) input.

## 3. Root Cause Analysis (Primary Trigger)
The primary trigger was a series of rapid, concurrent operator interactions across the distributed avionics architecture. Specifically, the Captain (Master/NODE_A) and First Officer (Spare/NODE_C) initiated identical flight management state transitions—entering cruise flight, cost index, and block data—within seconds of each other `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 452 | UUID: 617d7ec2-f3cb-4c72-9e91-dad25091f63e]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 456 | UUID: 1a54739f-9dda-41a2-9936-82647f521ca9]`. This resulted in a high volume of state change requests being processed by the dual-mode system.

## 4. Failure Cascade & Propagation Sequence
1. **Initial State Transition:** NODE_A (Captain) initiated the "enter crz fl" (cruise flight) command `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 452 | UUID: 617d7ec2-f3cb-4c72-9e91-dad25091f63e]`.
2. **Redundant Command Entry:** Within one second, NODE_C (First Officer) initiated an identical "enter crz fl" command `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 456 | UUID: 1a54739f-9dda-41a2-9936-82647f521ca9]`.
3. **Parameter Modification Cascade:** Both nodes processed subsequent operator inputs for "cost index" `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 454 | UUID: dbfa6d34-51d1-4c56-8bed-6e4506717d2d]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 458 | UUID: fd358a70-f7e1-498d-8b51-587d03459c80]` and "block" data `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 455 | UUID: 78f8371e-64e6-4b74-a54d-82b63e1989ac]` `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 459 | UUID: 8d90a342-a617-4ce0-9172-61695c24e2a0]`.
4. **Performance Data Update:** The rapid succession of inputs triggered a "Performance Data Changed" event on NODE_A `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 456 | UUID: 1265bed4-85f7-41f5-a3c8-b1c0f9bc542c]` and subsequent updates on NODE_C `[Source: NODE_C_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 461 | UUID: fef80773-573e-4ca0-9e72-38e967a9f218]`.
5. **Flight Plan Source Shift:** The sequence concluded with NODE_A inserting a temporary flight plan from an external EFB source `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 472 | UUID: b713cf0f-a4ab-4efe-a19c-74f74bca396c]`.

## 5. System Impact Assessment
* **Redundancy Status:** The system maintained "Dual" mode throughout the duration of the event `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 452 | UUID: 617d7ec2-f3cb-4c72-9e91-dad25091f63e]`.
* **Functional Availability:** While functional availability remained intact, the system experienced a high density of events (55 events in 124 seconds), indicating a period of intense computational load during the synchronization of performance data.
* **Flight Management Mode:** The system successfully transitioned from primary FMS management to a "Temporary Efb" flight plan source on the Captain's node `[Source: NODE_A_FM_CI_BPQ_Log_6_Custom_Log_Decoded_Report.html | Seq: 472 | UUID: b713cf0f-a4ab-4efe-a19c-74f74bca396c]`.

## 6. Recommended Corrective & Maintenance Actions
1. **FMS Synchronization Logic Audit:** Conduct a software review of the FMS synchronization protocols to ensure that near-simultaneous identical inputs from Master and Spare nodes are de-conflicted or coalesced to prevent redundant processing cycles.
2. **EFB Integration Stability Test:** Perform hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testing to validate the stability of the "Temporary Efb" flight plan source transition, specifically monitoring for any latency in performance data propagation during external data injection.
3. **Operator Interface Review:** Evaluate the cockpit interface design to determine if the ability to perform identical high-level FMS modifications on both Master and Spare nodes simultaneously presents a risk of unintended data race conditions.
